fact_text: The founder of Samsung Group, a former chairman of Abad, said he has about 30 years of experience in the property field.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why Jinnah Avenue is Attracting Real Estate Investors | Pakistan Property Playbook' (YouTube, 2025-05-18)

fact_text: Samsung Grand 2 on Jinnah Avenue, Karachi, is built as four towers linked internally, with 12 franchise shops on the ground floor and 10 residential floors above.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why Jinnah Avenue is Attracting Real Estate Investors | Pakistan Property Playbook' (YouTube, 2025-05-18)

fact_text: The developer said Samsung Grand 2 was launched a few days before the interview and that construction had already begun on site.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why Jinnah Avenue is Attracting Real Estate Investors | Pakistan Property Playbook' (YouTube, 2025-05-18)

fact_text: The developer's stated completion schedule for Samsung Grand 2 is four years, extended from three to ease buyers' payments, with the developer saying it expects delivery before the three-year mark.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why Jinnah Avenue is Attracting Real Estate Investors | Pakistan Property Playbook' (YouTube, 2025-05-18)

fact_text: The project's sales office was quoting Samsung Grand 2 at PKR 18,500 per square foot at the time of the interview.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why Jinnah Avenue is Attracting Real Estate Investors | Pakistan Property Playbook' (YouTube, 2025-05-18)

fact_text: The smallest Samsung Grand 2 unit is about 1,080 sq ft gross, a two-bedroom lounge layout, and buyers may convert the lounge-drawing area into a third bedroom with a larger bathroom.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why Jinnah Avenue is Attracting Real Estate Investors | Pakistan Property Playbook' (YouTube, 2025-05-18)

fact_text: Under the Samsung Grand 2 payment plan, booking, confirmation and allotment amounts are the same for every buyer, and the balance may be split equally over the four-year schedule or customised by the buyer.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why Jinnah Avenue is Attracting Real Estate Investors | Pakistan Property Playbook' (YouTube, 2025-05-18)

fact_text: The developer said gross area includes service areas, lifts and shafts but excludes parking, and that each unit comes with one free parking space outside the gross area.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why Jinnah Avenue is Attracting Real Estate Investors | Pakistan Property Playbook' (YouTube, 2025-05-18)

fact_text: The developer argued Samsung Grand 2 is well located: it is on Jinnah Avenue, about 3 to 4 minutes from the airport road, Shahrah-e-Faisal and the M9 motorway, and it is near University Road and several Karachi universities.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why Jinnah Avenue is Attracting Real Estate Investors | Pakistan Property Playbook' (YouTube, 2025-05-18)

fact_text: The developer said the project fronts a 200-foot road that connects to University Road, and that the project's rear side has a society park that the developer plans to adopt.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why Jinnah Avenue is Attracting Real Estate Investors | Pakistan Property Playbook' (YouTube, 2025-05-18)

fact_text: The developer said sales skewed to larger apartments, against his expectation that buyers would focus on smaller units, and that buyers' needs have changed as conditions became harder.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why Jinnah Avenue is Attracting Real Estate Investors | Pakistan Property Playbook' (YouTube, 2025-05-18)

fact_text: The developer said the earlier Samsung Grand 1 project's sale price rose about 400 percent above its booking price, but he gave no guarantee of future returns.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why Jinnah Avenue is Attracting Real Estate Investors | Pakistan Property Playbook' (YouTube, 2025-05-18)

fact_text: The developer said low-cost housing needs schools, clinics, police stations and utilities, and suggested that the state designate an area where builders pay no tax if the tax saving passes to end buyers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why Jinnah Avenue is Attracting Real Estate Investors | Pakistan Property Playbook' (YouTube, 2025-05-18)
